title: Registered-agent eligibility rules, per jurisdiction
description: DRAFT - the starting contract, expected to change while the pilot runs. Records who may serve as an LLC's registered agent: whether the LLC itself may be its own agent, whether a commercial mail receiving agency address is acceptable, and the address rule in the state's own words. This namespace is authoritative for registered-agent eligibility; contact details stay in entitysearch-state-data.

llcCanBeOwnAgent.description: Whether the LLC itself may serve as its own registered agent. false is a researched finding and requires evidence from the registered-agent provision that would have said so; null means not yet researched.

cmraAllowed.description: Whether a commercial mail receiving agency (CMRA) may serve as the registered office or address. false is a researched finding and requires evidence.

addressRule.description: The address requirement in the state's own words: physical street address, P.O. box policy, business-office requirement.

notes.description: Anything the fields cannot carry without lying: the definitional calls behind llcCanBeOwnAgent and cmraAllowed.

needsReview.description: What is missing and what would settle it.

type.description: Source class, for deriving record confidence mechanically. null where none of the classes fits.

lastVerified.description: The date the cited pages were retrieved and every quoted passage was mechanically confirmed to occur in them.

quote.description: One contiguous verbatim passage, copied from the page as retrieved, artefacts included. Never assembled across an ellipsis, never taken from a search snippet, never tidied.

supports.description: Which value in the enclosing object this passage grounds, by field name (llcCanBeOwnAgent, cmraAllowed, addressRule). A record carrying several passages is only honest if each one says what it is evidence for.
